reviews.body: For the price point, getting Standard multi-core processor performance alongside 16GB / 32GB storage, microSD slot made the Panasonic Panasonic P85 Nxt an easy recommendation among rivals in 2015.

reviews.title: Smooth day-to-day software responsiveness
reviews.body: Operating on Android, the user interface is intuitive with smooth system transitions. Core apps and browsing run without noticeable stutter.

reviews.title: Dependable display and audio clarity
reviews.body: The screen (IPS LCD capacitive touchscreen) produces vibrant colors for video streaming, and call clarity through the earpiece is crystal clear.

reviews.title: A well-rounded package from Panasonic
reviews.body: Overall, the Panasonic Panasonic P85 Nxt proved to be a durable and well-engineered mobile device representing Panasonic's design philosophy nicely.
